alignmentReference.alignmentMethod: Mirrored source X and applied the active Unity2Skfb scene-root transform; verified against six named entrance transforms and the scene renderer bounds in Unity Editor.

limitations: The browser loads this optimized visual asset, not the Unity scene. Geometry alignment uses the scene root transform and glTF coordinate reflection, but its simplified meshes and surfaces are not surveyed or walkability-validated. Navigation route data is supplied separately by ../route-data.json; the Unity representative cutaway is not embedded in this model.
